name: 市職員の住居・通勤手当を見直す
summary: 現在、住居手当は対象職員に月15,000円を支給し、自転車等の通勤手当は月2,000円（原動機付は月2,300円）です。改正後は、家賃が月30,000円以上で、27歳に達した後の最初の3月31日までにある対象職員の住居手当を月30,000円にします。通勤手当は自転車等の距離に応じた額に変え、駐車場料金への補助を設ける一方、合計額に月15万円相当の上限を設けます。
changes: 住居手当を月15,000円から、条件により月30,000円にする
通勤手当の運賃相当額などの合計に、月15万円相当の上限を設ける
自転車等の通勤手当を距離区分ごとの額にし、月32,000円を上限とする（特例の上限は78,900円）
駐車場料金に対する通勤手当を設け、月5,000円を上限とする
who: 住居手当・通勤手当の対象となる府中市職員
why: 市職員の住居手当などを見直すためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises housing and commuting allowances for city employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Concerning Salaries of Fuchu City Employees
en.summary: Currently, eligible employees receive a housing allowance of ¥15,000 per month. The commuting allowance for bicycles, etc. is ¥2,000 per month (¥2,300 for motorized bicycles). Under the amendment, the housing allowance will be ¥30,000 per month for eligible employees who pay rent of at least ¥30,000 per month and are within the period ending on the first March 31 after they turn 27. Commuting allowances will be based on distance for bicycles, etc., and a subsidy for parking fees will be introduced. The combined amount will be subject to a cap equivalent to ¥150,000 per month.
changes: Raises the housing allowance from ¥15,000 to ¥30,000 per month, subject to conditions
Sets a cap equivalent to ¥150,000 per month on the combined commuting allowance amount
Sets commuting allowances for bicycles, etc. by distance bracket, capped at ¥32,000 per month (¥78,900 under special provisions)
Introduces a commuting allowance for parking fees, capped at ¥5,000 per month
who: Fuchu City employees eligible for the housing allowance
Fuchu City employees eligible for commuting allowances
Fuchu City employees eligible for commuting allowances
Fuchu City employees eligible for commuting allowances
en.why: The city says it is reviewing housing and other allowances for city employees.
